# Maheshwaram Properties

> Trusted real estate firm since 2002 offering DTCP & HMDA approved premium residential plots in Maheshwaram, Mansanpally and South Hyderabad — near ORR, Shamshabad International Airport and Pharma City. Services include plot sales, resale of properties, site visits, documentation and registration support.

## Ventures
- [Chalapathi Estates Kandukur](https://www.maheshwaramproperties.in/ventures/chalapathi-estates-kandukur.html): Chalapathi Estates Kandukur — DTCP approved Unique City Annexe gated community in Kandukur, Hyderabad. Plots from 2304 sq. ft with BT roads, avenue plantation and clear title. Near Srisailam Highway.
- [Chalapathi Garden](https://www.maheshwaramproperties.in/ventures/chalapathi-garden.html): Chalapathi Garden — DTCP approved residential plots established in 2002 in Mansanpally, Maheshwaram. Plot sizes 200–400 sq. yds with clear title, near Airport & ORR, Hyderabad.
- [Chalapathi Melbourne Kadthal](https://www.maheshwaramproperties.in/ventures/chalapathi-melbourne-kadthal.html): Chalapathi Melbourne Kadthal — 82-acre ready-to-move DTCP & RERA approved plotted township by Chalapathi Estates Pvt. Ltd. on Srisailam Highway near Pharma City, Hyderabad.
- [Chalapathi Paradise](https://www.maheshwaramproperties.in/ventures/chalapathi-paradise.html): Chalapathi Paradise — DTCP approved residential plots in Mansanpally, Maheshwaram. Black-top roads, underground drainage, avenue plantation. Near Rajiv Gandhi Airport & ORR, Hyderabad.
- [Cyber Space](https://www.maheshwaramproperties.in/ventures/cyber-space.html): Cyber Space — DTCP Approved residential land development in Nagaram, Maheshwaram (Nandupally Grampanchayat). Clear title plots in residential zone near ORR and Shamshabad Airport.

- [Karvy Nova](https://www.maheshwaramproperties.in/ventures/karvy-nova.html): Karvy Nova — 130-acre premium gated residential plot venture near Outer Ring Road and Shamshabad Airport in Maheshwaram, Hyderabad. Underground electricity, landscaped gardens, black-top roads.
- [Magadha Riviera](https://www.maheshwaramproperties.in/ventures/magadha-riviera.html): Magadha Riviera — DTCP approved eco-friendly plotted community near Pendyal village, Maheshwaram mandal, Hyderabad. Two natural lakes, tree-lined avenues, underground drainage and blacktop roads, 15 km from Shamshabad International Airport.
- [Meher Crown City](https://www.maheshwaramproperties.in/ventures/meher-crown-city.html): Meher Crown City — DTCP Approved residential layout in Maheshwaram with wide 60, 40 & 33 ft internal roads. Near ORR Exit No. 14, Airport, Fab City, TCS Adibatla and Ramky Discovery City.
- [Palm Meadows](https://www.maheshwaramproperties.in/ventures/palm-meadows.html): Palm Meadows — 16-acre serene gated residential community with 203 plots in Mansanpally, Maheshwaram, Hyderabad. Underground drainage, 24/7 security.
- [Rich Green Bagh Mankhal](https://www.maheshwaramproperties.in/ventures/rich-green-bagh-mankhal.html): Rich Green Bagh Mankhal — HMDA approved premium plotted venture at Baghmankhal, Hyderabad. Wide BT roads, avenue plantation & underground utilities near ORR, TCS, Wonderla & Adibatla IT corridor.
- [Sai Nikita Paradise](https://www.maheshwaramproperties.in/ventures/sai-nikita-paradise.html): Sai Nikita Paradise — 13.65-acre gated community with 149 residential plots in Thummloor, Maheshwaram. Plots from 1800–5400 sq. ft.
- [Shreya Green Meadows](https://www.maheshwaramproperties.in/ventures/shreya-green-meadows.html): Shreya Green Meadows — 12-acre HMDA & TG-RERA approved plotted community at Mansanpally X Road, Maheshwaram, by Shreya Infra Group. 146 plots ranging 141–230 sq. yds with premium amenities.
- [Song of the South](https://www.maheshwaramproperties.in/ventures/song-of-the-south.html): Song of the South — Premium residential layout in Dubbacharla, Maheshwaram. DTCP approved open plots near ORR, Srisailam Highway, and Shamshabad Airport.

Clear titles with families already moving in. Near ORR & Shamshabad Airport.
